messages:
maria: Hey team — planning to move ff_multi_region_failover to 'staged' for a 5% canary on login-service across eu-west1 & us-west1. Goal: verify failover routing and sticky sessions before bigger rollout. Flip window tomorrow 10:30 PST. Can people ack guardrails?

jonathan: Ack. Couple Qs — how are we handling stickiness? cookie vs header? If sticky, KV cache migration for session keys needs a look. Also need to confirm fallback model mapping (use model-small in fallback regions) so latency stays bounded.

sam: I can update route policy to preserve session-affinity via cookie. I'll prep a small config patch and link PR. Quick command I use to stage flags locally:
```
./infra/flags set ff_multi_region_failover --env prod --state staged --audience canary_eu5
```
I'll also add fallback_order to route_policy_v2 so failover picks the right region.

eli: Please add Prom alerts before flipping: ALRT_FAILOVER_ERRORS (>2% error increase over 5m) and ALRT_FAILOVER_P99 (>300ms p99). Also implement an auto-rollback hook if either fires.

deploy-bot: scheduled toggle job created by @maria for thread 1745123456 -> window 2025-04-06T18:30:00Z :calendar:

maria: Thanks — PR is https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/824. @jonathan @sam please review; I will not flip until both approvals. For canary audience we only target users with region_cookie set and new routing header.

jonathan: Reviewing now. I'll run tools/canary_check.sh against eu-west1 once staged. Also ensure Redis KV pref has replicas in fallback regions to avoid cold-cache latency spikes.

sam: Pushed config snippet to PR summary:
```
{"flag":"ff_multi_region_failover","scope":["login-service"],"canary":{"percent":5,"regions":["eu-west1","us-west1"]},"fallback_order":["us-central1","us-east1"],"stickiness":{"type":"cookie","ttl":"24h"}}
```
:thumbsup:

eli: I'll add the Prom alerts and a Grafana panel for canary latency. Proposed rollback condition: >2% error rate OR p99 >300ms for 10m, or >10% drop in traffic to primary region.

maria: Awesome — stopping here. Ping this thread once staged. If anyone can't make the 10:30 window, shout now.
